rationale: Argmax diagnostic has one completed Level-7 game (seed10013, score486) but seven persistent waiting states; that unfinished suite cannot qualify. Test a globally uniform epsilon-greedy learned policy, not a status-conditioned serve fallback.

method.description: At every action, independently of the screen or game status, use a uniformly random one of six actions with probability0.01; otherwise choose the learned policy-logit argmax.
method.source_scope: Mnih et al. 2015 used epsilon-greedy DQN evaluation at epsilon0.05. This diagnostic borrows the generic exploration mechanism at preselected epsilon0.01 for PPO-trained logits; not a replication of DQN or proof of improvement.

launch_after: Terminal completion of argmax diagnostic98396; do not stop either active learner.
selection_rule: All20 games must finish GAME OVER without truncation. Compare the complete suite's descending level-reach rank against sampled f58 primary. Only a strictly stronger depth rank warrants a 50-game secondary diagnostic in exactly this same epsilon-greedy mode; no fresh final-test seeds for selection. Never relabel a result as sampled PPO or silently change the live training/validation protocol.
